feature_name: Multiline CAST Expression Support in Views
description: Update the view collection parsing logic to properly recognize multiline CAST expressions. Currently, CAST expressions that span multiple lines are not detected, causing their field types to be marked as unknown. This fix will ensure that SQL views containing multiline CAST operations correctly identify field types.
functional_requirements: Modify the regular expression pattern used for detecting CAST expressions to handle newline characters
Ensure the pattern correctly matches CAST expressions that span multiple lines, such as those with window functions or formatted SQL
Update the view parsing logic to apply the modified regex with appropriate flags for multiline matching
Add comprehensive unit tests to verify that multiline CAST expressions are properly recognized and their field types are correctly identified
Maintain backward compatibility with existing single-line CAST expressions in views
